Hold exact SHA-256, Git blob, length, class, and policy records for the complete protected runtime set.
Verify covered bytes before response; block unlisted executable sources; enforce exact verified-cache fallback and external SRI.

retained_failed_runs.finding: Harness expected a later resolver error name although the map was already blocked with HTTP 412.
Playwright required stability for an intentionally animated Guardian button.
Historical verification receipt wait used the wrong page context.
Historical Home visibly restored, but evidence was not read from the nested frame.
The restored Home removed the shim's storage-only verification receipt.
A brittle workflow-time harness rewrite did not match the committed source.
Resolver tampering was correctly blocked by an earlier equivalent fail-closed layer.
All 46 recorded assertions passed; the final historical attack still polled localStorage only.
Network-route interception did not affect the Home shim's in-page fetch.

defects_closed: A protected Pass 7.5 script could replace the integrity Service Worker; it is now observer-only.
Historical verification evidence did not survive document restoration; it now survives in window state, embedded JSON, and localStorage.
Manifest identity depended on audit/workflow commit SHA and a pre-finalization self-digest; it is now deterministic from the protected runtime set.
Manifest publisher races could seal stale protected bytes; concurrency and watched inputs now drive the latest atomic seal.
